title: Hammer Star
caption:
Two candles that can warn you a move is running out of steam.

The hammer: a long lower wick and a small body near the top. After a fall, buyers fought back. The shooting star is the opposite: after a rise, sellers pushed back.

Location matters. At support or resistance, they're worth noticing. And wait for the next candle to confirm.

Practise spotting them at memestreet.net

Fictional market. Not investment advice.

narration: Two candles that can warn you a move is running out of steam. The hammer has a long lower wick, and a small body near the top. After a fall, it shows sellers pushed price down, but buyers fought it back. The shooting star is the opposite. A long upper wick, and a small body near the bottom. After a rise, it shows buyers tried, and sellers pushed back. Location matters. At support or resistance, they're worth noticing. In the middle of nowhere, they're just noise. And wait for the next candle to confirm. Practise spotting them at memestreet.net.
